localization_rule: After freeze, exact source paths explicitly named in the public issue body may be used to restrict candidate generation; otherwise use all eligible non-test Java source.
memory_order: stable sort by retained operator score descending, then frozen generator order
pass_rule: Frozen baseline reproduces the issue; a zero-LLM candidate with winning operator integer_delta passes the frozen issue objective and regressions; exact replay passes.
transfer_rule: A positive Java result with the same retained integer_delta strategy, together with JavaScript A2 and Python A3, establishes the three-language A5 DEVELOPMENT threshold.
